visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a metallic elevator, a young boy with a black bowl cut, wearing a striped long-sleeved shirt and a peach-colored vest, holds a large pink Kirby plush toy tightly to his chest. He looks forward with a curious expression. (2) Transitioning to a shopping mall, a man in a black sweatshirt with 'STAFF' printed on the back walks away from the camera, leading the boy by the hand through a bright, modern corridor filled with other shoppers. (3) At a themed event space, the boy and two other children sit on pink plastic stools in front of a vibrant purple and black backdrop featuring Kirby illustrations. They pose for photos as people move around them in the well-lit hall. (4) The boy approaches a large, rounded Kirby statue equipped with blue and yellow headphones. He continues to hold his own Kirby plush while standing beside the larger figure under soft studio-style lighting. (5) In a high-traffic area of the mall, the camera pans across a pop-up store branded 'Kirby's Toki-Meki Crane Fever', showing shelves stocked with various pink merchandise and a crowd of people waiting behind stanchions. (6) The boy meets a large person-sized Kirby mascot. He stands next to it, making a peace sign with his fingers while the mascot waves its rounded arms. The background is a brightly colored event wall.
